scope: Proposition 2.1 (Square of a charge) of the manuscript “The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model” (preprints/The-unique-threshold-bound-state-of-the-SU-N-BFSS-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 270 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7a4b12bd2a7e8902), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the gauge-invariant core, H(h, m) = 1 2 p2 + Uh,m + i 2 θt (︃ 3 2 mT − hKjγj )︃ θ, Kj = ad(xj), 2Uh,m = ∑ cyc |h[xa, xb] − 2mxc|2 + h2 ∑ i<j j>3 ⃓ ⃓[xi, xj] ⃓ ⃓2 + m2 9 ∑ d=4 |xd|2 , Dv(h, m)2 = H(h, m) + mJ(R(v)), R(v)ij = sjvt γi γj Tv. (2.4) The cyclic sum uses (a, b, c) = (1, 2, 3), (2, 3, 1), (3, 1, 2). The matrix R(v) is skew, preserves R3 ⊕ R6, and has zero spin-basis average. The same formulas hold for an orthogonal direct sum of compact color algebras and abelian color spaces.
